latest_news.headline: Oil hits two-week high after Gulf infrastructure attack
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Brent near $111 after a drone attack on the UAE Barakah nuclear power plant, Saudi drone intercepts, and stalled Iran/Hormuz talks.

latest_news.headline: Iran ceasefire described as on life support
latest_news.text: AP reported Trump called the Iran ceasefire on life support while Hormuz restrictions, blockade disputes, and uranium demands remained unresolved.

latest_news.headline: Iran reviews US proposal but nuclear demands unresolved
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Iran was reviewing a US proposal to end the war while enriched uranium disposal, missile limits, and proxy support remained unaddressed.

latest_news.headline: Israel and Lebanon extend ceasefire by 45 days
latest_news.text: Reuters says Washington talks extended the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and set security and political follow-up tracks, despite continued southern Lebanon hostilities.

latest_news.headline: Israeli strikes kill Palestinians in Gaza
latest_news.text: Reuters reported fresh Israeli strikes in Gaza while Israel and Hamas remain deadlocked in indirect talks over the post-war plan.

latest_news.headline: Hamas Gaza armed wing chief killed
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Israel killed Izz al-Din al-Haddad, Hamas armed wing chief in Gaza, the most senior Hamas official killed since the October ceasefire.

latest_news.headline: Zelenskiy warns of Russia-Belarus NATO option
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Zelenskiy said Russia is considering operations from Belarus either toward northern Ukraine or directly against a NATO country.

latest_news.headline: Ceasefire violations continue in Ukraine war
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Russia and Ukraine traded accusations of violating a US-backed pause, with drone strikes and nearly 210 battlefield clashes.

latest_news.headline: UN monthly agenda keeps Sudan and regional spillover in frame
latest_news.text: UN/Security Council reporting continues to flag Sudan humanitarian and conflict pressure, but no fresh multi-source escalation threshold was met.

latest_news.headline: Trump China trip yields pageantry, limited Taiwan de-risking
latest_news.text: Reuters coverage of the China trip showed no new PLA surge but no durable Taiwan risk reduction; China-Taiwan remains elevated baseline.
